source: Live recording from DeepSeek (deepseek-flash) through its Anthropic-format API, 2026-10-03.

content.text: It's 14:05, so next up is chợ Hàn (Hàn market, the central market by the river) at 15:00 — good timing for a snack and some wandering. After that it's quiet until Cầu Rồng at 21:00, so there's a nice gap for dinner or a nap.
